title: Trial Attorney (Health Care Fraud)
description:
Hiring Organization
  
National Fraud Enforcement Division
  
Hiring Office
  
National Fraud Enforcement Division
  
Attorney Appointment Type
  
Attorney Term
  
  

**Location:**  

Multiple Locations
  
  

**Application Deadline:**  

Thursday, May 14, 2026
  
About the Office
  
  

The Department of Justice’s National Fraud Enforcement Division (“Fraud Division”) investigates and prosecutes those who commit fraud against the American people. We fulfill our mission by using advanced data\-driven investigative techniques; coordinating with agencies responsible for administering taxpayer\-funded programs; partnering with federal, tribal, state, territorial, and local law enforcement on fraud\-fighting efforts; developing systems and processes that ensure efficient identification and investigation of fraud; and equipping prosecutors and law enforcement with state\-of\-the\-art tools and resources needed to bring criminal actors to justice. The Fraud Division works every day to protect the financial integrity of the United States of America, ensure the vibrancy of the American economy, and seek justice for victims of fraud.
  
  

Job Description
  
  

The National Fraud Enforcement Division, U.S. Department of Justice, is seeking qualified, experienced attorneys for three\-year renewable term positions in the Fraud Division's Health Care Fraud (HCF) Strike Force located in the Northern District of California, Arizona, and Nevada. The incumbent will serve as a Trial Attorney in HCF and, as such, will independently direct, conduct, and monitor investigations, prepare for and conduct trials, and advise on pleadings and other court filings. Upon accepting an offer of employment, applicants must make a three\-year commitment to the Fraud Division.
  
  

The Fraud Division's HCF is comprised of prosecutors who are based in Strike Force cities, travel to Strike Force cities from Washington D.C., and are based in Washington D.C. or other Strike Force cities as members of the National Rapid Response Strike Force. The National Rapid Response Strike Force investigates multi\-jurisdictional and corporate health care fraud.
  
  

**Generally, as a Trial Attorney in the HCF, the incumbent:**  

Handles the development and management of HCF prosecutions. Engages in all phases of investigation and litigation, including, but not limited to, the use of grand jury, advising federal law enforcement agents, preparing appropriate pleadings, litigating motions, and conducting trials in U.S. District Court;
  
Makes charging decisions and proposes dispositions with regard to assigned cases; and
  
In collaboration with managers, develops and maintains the Fraud Division's program to foster effective investigation and prosecution of HCF violations, including advising on strategy and legal complexities, and developing litigation priorities, policy and legislative recommendations.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Required Qualifications:** Interested applicants must possess a J.D., or equivalent, degree, be duly licensed and authorized to practice as an attorney under the laws of any State, territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia, and be an active member of the bar in good standing.
  
  

**Grade Specific Qualifications:**  

To qualify at the GS\-14 grade level, applicants must have at least two and a half (2\.5\) years post J.D. legal experience, one of which was specialized experience at, or equivalent to, the GS\-13 grade level. Examples of specialized experience include: performing legal analysis and formulating recommendations to senior managers; composing pleadings, briefs, and other court documents involving legal issues in civil or criminal litigation; and conducting civil or criminal litigation.
  
To qualify at the GS\-15 grade level, applicants must have at least four (4\) years post J.D. legal experience, one of which was specialized experience at, or equivalent to, the GS\-14 grade level. Examples of specialized experience include: independently performing legal analysis; composing pleadings, briefs and other court documents involving unique and/or difficult legal issues in civil or criminal litigation; conducting highly complex civil or criminal litigation; and leading paralegals and support staff.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

Experience as a criminal prosecutor.
  
Experience with civil or criminal health care fraud matters.
  
Knowledge of white collar criminal litigation.
  
Experience in supporting, litigating, and supervising federal or state criminal cases.
  
Experience in U.S. District Court or state court.
  
Experience with the federal judiciary.
  
Application Process
  
  

The Application Package must be received by 11:59 PM, Eastern Time, on the closing date of this announcement. Please submit your application package to FraudDivisionHiring@usdoj.gov .
  
  

**A complete application package must include:**  

Cover Letter (highlighting relevant experience).
  
Resume \- Applicants will be evaluated based on a comparison of the position requirements against the quality and extent of experience or related education as reflected in their resume. Applicants are encouraged to ensure work experiences clearly show the possession of knowledge of the subject matter pertinent to the position and the technical skills to successfully perform the duties of the position. Your resume must be no more than 2 pages. Resumes longer than 2 pages will not be accepted. Please ensure all information you believe is qualifying for the position is contained within your resume, or you may be marked ineligible. Additionally, your resume must include your JD date and the following information for each job listed: month and year, start/end dates (e.g. June 2007 to April 2008\), and full\-time or part\-time status (include hours worked per week).
  
**Writing Sample:** Not to exceed 10 pages.
  
Documentation of eligibility for special hiring authorities (if applicable) to prove appointment eligibility. Examples include: Schedule A disability letter, Peace Corps volunteer letter, military spouse hiring authority documentation, etc.
  
Current or Former Political Appointees (if applicable) \- please note on your resume and attach an SF\-50\. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non\-Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office.
  
Schedule A Documentation (if applicable) \- The Fraud Division welcomes and encourages applications from persons with disabilities and is firmly committed to satisfying its affirmative obligations under the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 to ensure that persons with disabilities have every opportunity to be hired and advanced on the basis of merit within the Department.
  
  

**Veterans Preference Documentation (if applicable):**  

If you are a discharged, non\-disabled veteran, you must submit a copy of your DD\-214 showing character discharge (Member 4 copy), or other Documentation of Service and Separation under Honorable Conditions. If you don't have your DD\-214, you may request it after discharge from the National Archives at www.archives.gov/veterans.
  
If you are a veteran within 120 days of discharge, you must submit signed documentation from the Armed Forces certifying: 1\) your expected release/retirement from active duty, 2\) under honorable conditions, 3\) your pay grade/rank/rate at time of discharge, 4\) dates of active duty service, 5\) any campaign or expeditionary medals received, and 6\) dated within 120 days of your separation.
  
If you are a disabled veteran, Purple Heart recipient, or mother or spouse of a disabled or deceased veteran, you must submit a completed SF\-15 http://www.opm.gov/forms/pdf\_fill/SF15\.pdf and all additional proof required by the SF\-15, as applicable. If you don't have your Department of Veterans Affairs letter establishing proof of disability, you may request it at https://www.va.gov/resources/getting\-started\-with\-va/ or call 1\-800\-827\-1000\.

We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Experience: 5–8 years in HR Generalist roles, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. Experience in hospitality, retail, FMCG, or multi\-location businesses preferred.
 



 Location: Shahpur Jat, New Delhi
 



 Work Schedule: 6 days working (Sunday off)
 



 Work Timings: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm
 



 Job Type: Full\-time
 



**About us** 




 Established in 1962, Defence Bakery stands as a revered pillar of Delhi's culinary landscape, renowned for its rich heritage and steadfast dedication to quality. As one of the city's oldest bakery, Patisserie, and Confectionery establishments, we take pride in our simple yet authentic approach to business, which has propelled us to consistent growth over the years. In 2018, it successfully launched its sister brand “Alma Bakery and Cafe” with a deep\-rooted commitment to delivering excellence in culinary delights to the discerning palates of Noida. We are deeply dedicated to fostering a sustainable community through our core values of innovation, a people\-first approach, and excellent legacy products \& services. For further details please visit us at www.defencebakery.in and www.almafoods.in for more details.
 



**Job Summary** 




 As a
 **Human Resources Manager** 
 , you will be responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end HR operations, ensuring statutory compliance, and strengthening employee engagement across the organization. The role manages payroll, recruitment coordination, onboarding, performance support, employee relations, and compliance with labour laws, while maintaining HR systems and data integrity. The position works closely with Operations Head to align HR processes with business objectives and drive operational efficiency.
 



**Roles \& responsibilities** 



* Managing End\-to\-End HR Operations\-Manage daily HR functions including recruitment coordination, onboarding, payroll processing, attendance management, and full \& final settlements.
* Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding\-Support timely hiring through multiple sourcing channels and ensure structured induction programs across all business units.
* Payroll \& Statutory Compliance\-Administer accurate and timely payroll while ensuring full compliance with central, state, and local labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Employee Relations \& Engagement\-Address employee grievances, conduct investigations, guide managers on employee matters, and drive engagement initiatives such as R\&R and team\-building activities.
* Performance Management Support\-Define KPIs, support appraisal frameworks, and align performance improvement initiatives with organizational goals.
* HR Systems \& Data Governance\-Maintain HRMS accuracy, ensure employee data confidentiality, and generate HR analytics and reports for informed decision\-making.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Audits\-Stay updated on labour law changes, conduct internal compliance audits, maintain statutory documentation, and coordinate regulatory reporting.
* Risk \& Policy Management\-Identify compliance risks, implement preventive controls, strengthen HR policies, and collaborate with leadership/legal advisors to mitigate organizational risk.



**Qualifications** 



* Master Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* HR certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR) is preferred.



**Experience** 



* 5–8 years in HR Generalist roles, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. Experience in hospitality, retail, FMCG, or multi\-location businesses preferred.
* Experience in
 **multi\-location workforce management**
* Exposure to
 **blue\-collar \+ white\-collar workforce**
* Managed payroll for at least
 **80–150\+ employees**
* Experience in compliance inspections or labour department interactions
* Handled employee disciplinary cases \& domestic inquiries (if applicable)



 If interested, please send your resume at
 
 talent@defencebakery.in

title: Senior Manager of Human Resources
description:
About IntouchCX
  
  

IntouchCX is a global leader in customer experience management, digital engagement, and AI and automation solutions. We immerse ourselves in your world with curiosity, creativity, and innovation to deliver exceptional results. For over 20 years, we have scaled with soul to become a disruptive industry leader by building trusted long\-term relationships with our brand partners and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  

About the Job
  
  

The Senior Manager of Human Resources supervises and ensures the effective execution and administration of Human Resources (HR) activities and contributes to the overall positive effect of the HR team.
  
  

This person is a key component to the department, and will bring a strong influence on the organizational development of our company from a leadership, employee engagement, and management perspective.
  
  

As Senior Manager of Human Resources, You Will…
  
  

* Coach employees, HR Team members and managers on development needs, career growth, and learning opportunities
* Identify and initiate human resource process improvements
* Support the communication, reporting and related governance of employment regulations
* Conduct competitive market analysis of compensation and benefit programs
* Maintain human resource databases, computer software systems, and manual filing systems in conjunction with other HR personnel
* Support program execution and implementation associated with people\-related change initiatives and HR deliverables
* Collaborate with various departments and leaders, locally and across the globe, managing and driving results of our people operations programs
* Support and drive the IntouchCX culture within their teams and through all teams and programming
* Conduct special projects as assigned
* Demonstrated expertise in developing and managing relationships with internal customers
* Produce accurate and relevant metrics and reports

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Role:** Business Analyst — Strategy \& Growth**Reporting To:** Strategy Consultant**Experience:** 0–2 Years (Freshers actively encouraged)**Type:** Full\-Time **About the Role**
We are looking for a sharp, analytically driven individual who thrives on making sense of numbers, processes, and business realities. This role sits at the heart of how we run, improve, and grow our business — and you will be expected to bring structure, curiosity, and a bias for action to everything you do.
Reporting directly to the Strategy Consultant, your primary focus will be on ensuring the business unit runs efficiently — tracking performance, strengthening controls, writing and improving processes, and driving operational excellence. Over time, you will also support strategic initiatives including M\&A evaluation and IPO\-related data preparation.**Key Responsibilities****A. Business Unit P\&L \& Operational Performance*** Own the monthly P\&L review process — track revenue lines, cost heads, gross margins, and EBITDA; identify variances against budget and prior periods.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports, financial dashboards, and performance scorecards for leadership on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Analyse trends in revenue, cost, and profitability across business lines, customers, and geographies to surface actionable insights.
* Monitor working capital metrics — debtor days, creditor days, inventory levels, and cash flow patterns — and flag concerns proactively.
* Track and report on key business KPIs; build simple models to forecast performance and test sensitivities.
* Assist in annual budgeting and quarterly re\-forecasting exercises by compiling inputs, challenging assumptions, and preparing consolidated views.
* Design and maintain internal control mechanisms to prevent revenue leakage, cost overruns, and compliance lapses.
* Conduct periodic internal audits of transactions, approvals, and reconciliations; escalate exceptions to the reporting manager.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables; liaise with accounts team to ensure timely closures and accurate books.

**B. Process Writing \& Continuous Improvement*** Document existing business processes across departments in a structured, clear format — creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flowcharts, and control checklists.
* Identify process gaps, redundancies, and manual workarounds; propose and help implement streamlined alternatives.
* Work with teams on the ground to understand how work actually gets done vs. how it is supposed to get done — and design practical solutions that stick.
* Establish a process review calendar and ensure SOPs are updated periodically to reflect changes in operations, regulations, or systems.
* Track implementation of process improvement initiatives and measure impact through defined metrics (turnaround time, error rates, cost savings, etc.).
* Support automation and digitisation efforts by mapping current processes and identifying candidate workflows for technology intervention.
* Build a centralised process documentation repository accessible to relevant stakeholders.

**C. Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) Support*** Assist in identifying and profiling potential M\&A targets — compile company overviews, financial summaries, and industry context.
* Build and maintain financial models for deal evaluation — including revenue projections, cost structures, and basic valuation frameworks (DCF, revenue multiples).
* Prepare structured investment briefs and evaluation summaries for presentation to decision\-makers.
* Support due diligence by collating and organising financial data, contracts, regulatory filings, and operational information.
* Track relevant sector trends, publicly available deal data, and comparable transaction benchmarks.

**D. IPO Readiness — Data \& Preparation Support*** Assist in collating and organising historical financial data, operational metrics, and business disclosures required for IPO documentation.
* Compile inputs for the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) as directed — primarily data gathering, formatting, and fact\-checking.
* Coordinate with auditors, legal advisors, and merchant bankers to provide requested information in a timely manner.
* Maintain an IPO readiness tracker covering pending action items, document submissions, and milestone timelines.
* Prepare basic benchmarking data on listed peer companies — valuations, financials, and disclosure formats — for reference by senior advisors.

**What We Are Looking For****Qualifications*** Chartered Accountant (CA) — Fresher or up to 2 years post\-qualification (preferred)
* MBA (Finance / Strategy) from a reputed institution, OR
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce / Economics with prior experience at a reputed corporate, Big 4, or consulting firm.

**Skills \& Attributes*** Strong analytical mindset — ability to structure problems, work with numbers, and present findings clearly.
* Solid understanding of financial statements, P\&L mechanics, and accounting fundamentals.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; working knowledge of financial modelling and MIS reporting.
* Excellent written communication — able to write crisp SOPs, process notes, and analytical reports.
* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven, yet able to see the larger business picture.
* High ownership mindset — takes tasks to completion without needing to be followed up.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, multi\-priority environment where the scope of work evolves.
* Intellectual curiosity across domains — finance, operations, strategy, and business law.

title: Desktop Support Engineer L1
description:
**Job Summary**  
A Desktop Support Engineer provides technical assistance to end\-users, ensuring that desktops, laptops, and peripheral devices function efficiently. The role involves diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, managing installations and upgrades, and maintaining system security. They serve as the first line of IT support, helping employees remain productive by minimizing downtime and ensuring reliable system performance.

**Key Responsibilities**  
The Desktop Support Engineer is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining desktops, laptops, printers, and other peripherals. They troubleshoot hardware, software, and network connectivity issues, provide technical support through phone, email, or onsite visits, and manage operating system updates, patches, and antivirus protection. The role also includes setting up user accounts and permissions, documenting support requests and resolutions, collaborating with IT teams to escalate complex issues, and ensuring compliance with IT policies and security standards.

**Qualifications**  
Candidates should hold a bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. They must have strong knowledge of Windows and Mac operating systems, Microsoft Office applications, and basic networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP. Experience with ticketing systems like ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk is desirable. Certifications such as CompTIA A\+ or Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST) are preferred.

**Skills**  
The role requires excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities, strong communication and customer service skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Attention to detail, time management, and multitasking skills are essential for success in this position.

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
**We are hiring a Delivery Coordinator to join our engineering delivery team. This is an entry\-level role designed for freshers who are organized, proactive, and want to build a career at the intersection of project management and quality assurance.**  
**Your job is simple to describe but challenging to do well: make sure the projects you support are delivered on time. You will not write code, you will not design test cases on your own, and you will not handle clients. Instead, you will be the person who keeps everyone honest about commitments, surfaces problems early, and makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.**  
**You will work alongside experienced PMs, QAs, and engineers who will train you. Over 12–18 months, you can grow into a full Delivery Coordinator role with ownership of multiple projects.**

**What You'll Do (Day to Day)**

* Attend daily standups and take notes on what every team member committed to — and follow up the next day to check if it actually happened.
* Maintain the project tracker (JIRA / ClickUp) — make sure every ticket has a clear status, owner, and due date. Chase team members to update stale tickets.
* Help the PM prepare sprint plans by listing pending stories, dependencies, and blockers.
* Track QA cycles — when testing starts, how many bugs are open, when signoff is expected — and flag delays early.
* Maintain a simple risk and blocker list for each project; nudge owners to resolve them.
* Prepare weekly delivery status updates for the PM and engineering leads — what's on track, what's at risk, what needs attention.
* Coordinate release readiness checks — make sure deployment steps, smoke tests, and signoffs are completed before any release goes live.
* Sit in on demos and retrospectives, take notes, and convert feedback into tracked action items.

**What We're Looking For**  
This role is about attitude and habits more than experience. We will train you on tools and processes. What we cannot train is:

* Genuine ownership — when something is on your list, it gets done. You do not need to be reminded twice.
* Comfort with follow\-up — you are okay nudging an engineer or QA five times in a day to keep work moving. You do not feel awkward asking 'is this done yet?'
* Attention to detail — you notice when a ticket is missing a due date, when a status hasn't been updated for three days, when a deployment checklist has a step that was skipped.
* Clear written communication in English — short, factual updates without unnecessary jargon.
* Curiosity about software — you do not need to code, but you should be interested in how software is built, tested, and shipped.
* Patience and steadiness — delivery work is repetitive and detail\-heavy. You should find satisfaction in things running smoothly, not chaos.

**Eligibility**

* Any graduate (B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc, BBA, B.Com, or equivalent)
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

**What You'll Learn**  
**In your first 6 months, you will get hands\-on exposure to:**

* How real software projects are planned, estimated, and delivered to paying clients.
* Agile and Scrum practices in a working environment, not a textbook.
* Industry\-standard tools — JIRA, Slack, GitHub, staging environments, deployment pipelines.
* How QA, engineering, design, and PM functions work together — and how to spot when one of them is becoming a bottleneck.
* How to communicate risk and status clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

* Assist in creating or updating knowledge base articles to empower customers with self\-service solutions.

**What you will need**

* **Experience:** **6–9 years** of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .

title: Hospital Administrator
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Hospital Administrator**

*Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Elder Care Facility*

**Company**: Universal Elder Care

**Position**: Hospital Administrator

**Location**: Kovaipudur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Experience**: 0 – 3 Years (Healthcare preferred)

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time

**Industry**: Healthcare / Elder Care Services

**Qualification**: BHA / MBA (Hospital / Healthcare Management) or equivalent

**About Universal Elder Care**

Universal Elder Care is a dedicated elder care service provider located in Kovaipudur, Coimbatore. We offer a comprehensive range of residential and home\-based care services for senior citizens, including medical assistance, rehabilitation, nursing care, and wellness programs. Our facility is driven by a team of compassionate professionals committed to delivering the highest standard of care and dignity to every resident and client we serve.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Hospital Administrator to oversee the day\-to\-day administrative and operational functions of our elder care facility. The ideal candidate will serve as the backbone of our facility operations — ensuring smooth workflow between clinical teams, maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, managing facility resources, and delivering an excellent experience for residents and their families.

This is an excellent opportunity for early\-career professionals with a background in healthcare administration, hospital management, or a related discipline who wish to build a meaningful career in the elder care sector.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Facility Operations \& Administration**

* Oversee the overall day\-to\-day administrative operations of the elder care facility to ensure seamless functioning across all departments.
* Coordinate between clinical staff (doctors, nurses, physiotherapists, caregivers) and administrative personnel to ensure integrated service delivery.
* Maintain and update operational procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and facility policies in alignment with best practices.
* Monitor facility workflows and identify gaps or inefficiencies, recommending improvements to senior management.
* Manage facility schedules including staff duty rosters, shift allocation, and leave planning to ensure round\-the\-clock coverage.
* Supervise housekeeping, maintenance, security, laundry, and dietary departments to maintain facility standards.

**2\. Patient / Resident Admission \& Records Management**

* Coordinate the admission, discharge, and transfer processes for residents, ensuring a smooth and dignified experience for residents and their families.
* Maintain accurate and complete resident records including medical histories, treatment plans, consent forms, and progress documentation.
* Implement and manage the facility's Electronic Health Record (EHR) or Health Management Information System (HMIS) effectively.
* Ensure proper filing, retrieval, confidentiality, and security of all resident records in accordance with data protection norms.
* Prepare and maintain registers for admissions, discharges, incidents, complaints, and other mandatory records.

**3\. Regulatory Compliance \& Quality Assurance**

* Ensure the facility operates in full compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, licensing requirements, and government norms applicable to elder care institutions in Tamil Nadu.
* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and accreditation processes, preparing all required documentation and reports.
* Implement and monitor infection prevention and control (IPC) protocols and ensure all staff adhere to hygiene and safety standards.
* Maintain a comprehensive incident reporting system and ensure timely investigation and resolution of complaints, incidents, and near\-miss events.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and facilitate internal audits to uphold clinical and service delivery standards.

**4\. Human Resources \& Staff Coordination**

* Assist in recruitment, onboarding, and orientation of administrative and support staff.
* Maintain attendance, performance records, and leave management for non\-clinical staff in coordination with the HR department.
* Coordinate staff training programs, continuing education sessions, and skill development workshops.
* Address staff concerns, resolve minor workplace issues, and escalate critical matters to senior management.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained at all times, especially during emergencies or peak care periods.

**5\. Financial Administration \& Billing**

* Oversee resident billing processes including preparation of invoices, fee collection, receipts, and follow\-up on outstanding payments.
* Maintain petty cash, day\-to\-day expense records, and vendor payment coordination in collaboration with the accounts team.
* Assist in budget planning for administrative departments and monitor adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with insurance agencies, TPAs (Third Party Administrators), and government health schemes for claims processing and reimbursements where applicable.
* Generate financial reports including revenue summaries, occupancy rates, and departmental expenditure for management review.

**6\. Procurement \& Inventory Management**

* Manage procurement of administrative and non\-clinical supplies including stationery, housekeeping materials, dietary items, and facility consumables.
* Maintain inventory records, monitor stock levels, and coordinate with approved vendors for timely replenishment.
* Obtain competitive quotations and ensure cost\-effective procurement without compromising quality.
* Maintain equipment registers, coordinate preventive maintenance schedules, and ensure timely repair of facility assets.
* Liaise with medical supply vendors for timely delivery of clinical consumables in coordination with the nursing team.

**7\. Resident \& Family Relations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for residents and their families for all administrative queries, concerns, and feedback.
* Conduct regular family interaction sessions and facility orientation programmes for new residents and their caregivers.
* Address and resolve resident or family complaints in a professional, empathetic, and timely manner.
* Maintain a visitor management system and ensure all visitors adhere to facility protocols and security procedures.
* Collect and analyze resident satisfaction feedback to identify areas for service improvement.

**8\. IT Systems \& Digital Administration**

* Manage the facility's digital systems including EHR software, scheduling tools, billing platforms, and communication systems.
* Ensure all administrative data is backed up, secure, and accessible to authorized personnel only.
* Prepare MIS reports, occupancy dashboards, and operational summaries for management review on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Coordinate with IT vendors for system maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Support digital initiatives such as telemedicine coordination, online appointment scheduling, and resident health portals.

**9\. Emergency Preparedness \& Safety**

* Develop and maintain facility emergency response plans including fire safety, medical emergencies, and natural disasters.
* Conduct periodic mock drills and safety training sessions for all staff members.
* Ensure all fire safety equipment, emergency exits, first aid kits, and medical emergency supplies are maintained and inspection\-ready.
* Liaise with local authorities including fire department, ambulance services, and healthcare bodies for emergency coordination.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospital Administration (BHA), Healthcare Management, Business Administration (MBA – Hospital Management), or a related field.
* Diploma in Hospital Administration or Healthcare Management will also be considered.
* Additional certifications in healthcare quality, patient safety, or facility management are an advantage.

**Experience**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in hospital or healthcare facility administration.
* Prior exposure to elder care, nursing home, rehabilitation centre, or multi\-speciality hospital environments is preferred.
* Freshers with strong academic credentials and a keen interest in healthcare administration are encouraged to apply.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Tamil and English.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic hospital management software.
* Understanding of healthcare regulations, patient rights, and clinical governance frameworks.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact professionally with residents, families, medical staff, and vendors.
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* High integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct in handling sensitive resident and organizational information.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience.
* A structured induction program and on\-the\-job mentoring from senior healthcare administrators.
* Exposure to diverse administrative functions in a full\-spectrum elder care environment.
* Opportunities for career advancement within a growing elder care organization.
* Continuous learning through training programs, workshops, and professional development initiatives.
* A meaningful and rewarding career that makes a real difference in the lives of senior citizens.
* Collaborative, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture.

**How to Apply**

Interested and eligible candidates are requested to submit their updated resume along with a brief statement of interest to our HR team. Please mention 'Hospital Administrator – Coimbatore' in the subject line of your application email.

Responsible for ensuring that all raw materials, in\-process samples, and finished products meet defined quality standards and regulatory requirements. The role focuses on maintaining product safety, compliance, and consistency in a packaged drinking water / beverage manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Quality Testing \& Analysis**

* Conduct physical, chemical, and microbiological testing of:
* Raw water
* Treated water (RO/UV/Ozonated)
* Finished packaged drinking water
* Monitor parameters like pH, TDS, turbidity, hardness, alkalinity, microbial load, etc.

* Monitor water treatment processes (RO, UV, Ozonation)

* Identify deviations and take corrective actions

* Maintain QC records, test reports, and batch records
* Ensure compliance with:
* BIS (IS 14543 for packaged drinking water)
* FSSAI regulations
* Internal quality standards
* Assist in audits and inspections

**4\. Hygiene \& Sanitation Control**

* Monitor plant hygiene and sanitation practices
* Conduct swab tests and environmental monitoring
* Ensure CIP (Cleaning\-in\-Place) procedures are followed

* Ensure lab instruments are calibrated (pH meter, TDS meter, spectrophotometer, etc.)
* Maintain calibration logs and records

* Identify non\-conforming products
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
* Report quality issues to management

**7\. Vendor \& Raw Material Quality**

* Inspect incoming packaging materials (bottles, caps, labels)
* Approve/reject based on quality parameters

title: Talent Partner ( Contract )
description:
Scopely is looking for a **Talent Partner ( Contract )** to join our team in Bangalore, India.



At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day \- whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.



Our Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding \& attracting the best of the best for our business. This team sits globally in the US, UK, Spain \& India and is on a mission to engage with top talent to Inspire Play, Every Day!


**What You'll Do:**


* Own and manage full life cycle recruitment for roles across our organisation in India.
* Source and engage potential hires, maintaining a strong passive candidate pipeline with high\-touch communication.
* Develop innovative strategies to connect with and interview potential candidates.
* Collaborate with the rest of the recruiting team to streamline and innovate the recruiting and hiring process.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with hiring managers to create a partnership that yields success, predictable results and credibility.
* Build trust with candidates and provide them with complete, accurate, and inspiring information about the company and each position.
* Manage the presentation, selection, offer, negotiation, closing, and administrative components involved in full lifecycle recruiting.
* Maintain close relationships with staffing partners/vendors to ensure the talent we hire meets Scopely's bar of expectations.
* Manage campus relationships and hiring initiatives for fresher recruitment.


**About You:**


* 2\+ years of experience in full life cycle recruiting or related field
* Experience in the gaming or entertainment industry is a plus
* Experience recruiting for engineering, product, and design roles
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information


At Scopely, we create games for everyone \- and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us \& embrace the adventure!

### **About Scopely**



Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO," along with "Stumble Guys," "Star Trek™ Fleet Command," "MARVEL Strike Force," "WWE Champions," the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies," and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.



Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely's position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like "MONOPOLY GO!" from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Niantic games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.



Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and "Best Workplaces for Innovators," Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.



Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.



Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. title: Manager - HRBP
description:
**Business Overview \-** 




  





***About Danone Group:***




  





 Mission: Bringing Health through Food to as Many people as Possible
 



  





 Danone is a global leader in food and beverages, focusing on Essential Dairy and Plant\-based products, Waters, and Specialized Nutrition. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible by creating nutritious products, raising awareness about healthy eating and drinking habits, and conducting our business sustainably.
 



  





 Danone’s dual focus on commercial performance and societal responsibility, combined with an ongoing commitment to innovation and the strengthening of its health\-oriented brands, has resulted in strong performance worldwide. With nearly 90,000 employees and products sold in over 120 markets, Danone has generated more than €27 billion in sales annually.
 



  





 More information can be found at www.danone.com.
 



  





***About Danone India:***




  





 India is among the countries in the APAC zone wherein Danone has its presence. Danone operates in India as Nutricia International Pvt. Ltd, focusing on nutrition with a range of products catering to pregnant mothers, infants, young children as well as adults. These products are manufactured in India and sold nationally under recognized brands such as Aptamil, Dexolac, Nusobee, and Protinex. Danone employs over 1,000 individuals across India and generates a turnover exceeding €170 million. The company's head office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a manufacturing facility situated in Lalru, Punjab.
 



  





 Danone India is a Great Place To Work® certified organization, which reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where people are empowered to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and feel a true sense of belonging.
 



  





 More information can be found at https://www.danone.in/
 



  





 Want to learn more about Careers at Danone India? Visit Danone Careers
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities:** 




  





 The HR Business Partner would be engaging with business stakeholders in key HR processes including head count requirement, performance management, people coaching, development conversations, coordinating learning activities, PDR and ASR process facilitation and all HR strategic projects implementation. The HRBP would also be responsible for managing employee relations and union management (if applicable in the Line of Business) which will involve discipline and grievances management, participating in domestic inquiries, managing litigations under various labor laws (if applicable), bottom quartile management and others related activities. Improving existing practices to ensure high \& positive internal employee experience would be key to the role. Collaborating with CBU HR teams for alignment and implementation of HR processes and sharing feedback for process improvements.
 



  





**Human Resources Management** 




  





*Performance Management*



* Deploy Danone People Conversations (C1 to C5\) in line with global processes and complete HR audits.
* Coordinate and manage Performance related processes Performance Calibration, Annual Salary Review and Short\-term Incentives payouts (STI)
* Discuss with line leaders on employee performance matters and plan for employees’ promotions/performance coaching
* Consolidate performance reviews with functional heads and give consolidated data and recommendations
* Coordinate and track PIP plans for bottom quartile performers







*Headcount Management*



* Partner with business leaders for understanding optimal headcount and positions, talent needs identification in line with business goals
* Manage headcount optimization based on business needs
* Partner with business for internal transfers and assessment of talent pool to meet re\-organization needs
* Coordinate and oversee field force hiring as per process and business need







*Talent*



* Deploy IJP process to identify internal talent as per business requirements
* Contribute to talent needs identification and job requisition on sHaRe for managerial population ICIMS, and participate in the interview process as panel with business stakeholders and share feedback for managerial positions
* Train people managers on all HR Processes (Target setting, PDR, ASR etc.)
* Review re\-hire requests and share feedback







*New Joiner Management*



* Support line managers on designing and planning functional inductions of new joiners (managerial) for early performance impact
* Supporting new joiner in knowing teams, important stakeholders, conducting introduction calls for new joiners
* Run HR sessions during the Basic Training Program (BTP) and induction plans for managers on field



  





  





*Attrition and Exit Management*



* Identification of attrition risks through EWS and create mitigation plan to ensure talent availability.
* Monthly attrition analysis with business stakeholders and creating action plan to manage attrition
* Manage exit process along with line leaders, engaging in retention conversations, negotiations, exit interviews etc.
* Advise business leaders on retention strategies for key talent and support on attrition management



  





*HR Policies*



* Suggesting improvements and leading changes in HR Policies and processes from time to time for enhancing employee experience
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and guidelines for the lines of business supported



  





*Rewards and Recognition*



* Co\-ordinate with people managers for R\&R policy and facilitating the process in respective Line of Business (LOB)



  





*Payroll Management*



* Share monthly payroll inputs to central payroll team
* Managing grievances with payroll team related to payroll\-Sodexo, Mediclaim etc.
* Share resignation details and F\&F inputs with payroll team and other stakeholders



  









**Employee Relations and Social Fundamentals** 




  





*Discipline Management*



* Investigate and take appropriate actions\- issue show cause notices \& charge sheets, termination letters etc.\- for noncompliance or disciplinary issues based on investigation reports
* Manage disciplinary issues in the line of business and address employee grievances
* Coach and advise line managers to enable them with strategies of discipline management
* Prepare and participate in domestic inquiries and labor court hearings as and when required



  





*Union Management*



* Manage Union matters and related grievances, demands, expectations
* Co\-ordinate with legal consultants on case\-to\-case basis and guidance



  





  





**Employee Connect and Engagement** 




  





*Engagement Surveys*



* Drive all surveys (Danone People Survey, Pulse survey etc.) and ensure maximum participation
* Create customized action plan based on survey results and employee feedback
* Validate the action plan with functional CODIs for deployment



  





*Employee Connects*



* Regular connect with employees, people managers and functional CODIs to understand areas of opportunities and way forward
* Deploy HR brown bags to gather employee feedback
* Partner with Safety Manager to deploy Health and wellbeing initiatives



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  




* MBA from a Tier\-1 B\-School
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience post MBA

 Bain \& Company is the management consulting firm that the world’s business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisition, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1\. Founded in 1973, Bain has offices in various countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
 







 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS).
 



 Global Business Services (GBS)
 



 is a network of five interconnected business\-function hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally.  Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 










  




**Job Summary** 






  



 We are seeking a strategic and hands\-on HR Business Partner to support two critical dimensions of our organization:
 








  


* Serving as the HR Business Partner for the Executive Assistant (EA) and Management Assistant (MA) population across Asia Pacific (APAC) (50%), and
* Leading HR for our Global Business Services (GBS) Kuala Lumpur office, (50%).

**2\. GBS HR Lead – GBS Kuala Lumpur (\~50%)**

* Act as a trusted advisor to office leadership, shaping talent strategy, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness for the KL office.

* Helping to shape a strong office culture and employee experience, including engagement, wellbeing, and inclusion initiatives tailored to the KL environment.







  




**3\. Talent Management, Rewards \& Organizational Effectiveness**









  


* Advise leaders on performance management, promotions, and compensation decisions across both scopes.
* Analyze engagement survey results and partner with the business to drive targeted action plans to improve employee experience and retention.
* Support organizational design, role clarity, and capability building initiatives.




  
 





**4\. Employee Relations \& Risk Management**









  


* Provide oversight and guidance on employee relations matters across APAC EA/MA and direct ownership for KL\-based cases.
* Ensure alignment between global standards and local legal requirements through close partnership with local HR and Legal teams.
* Proactively identify and mitigate HR\-related risks while balancing business needs and employee experience.


* Lead investigations and disciplinary processes in the GBS KL office with sensitivity and professionalism, ensuring fairness and compliance.
* Partner with local HR teams across APAC to ensure consistent handling of ER matters while maintaining compliance with local regulations.




  
 





**5\. HR**


**Activities** 


**, Projects \& Continuous Improvement**









  


* Lead and support the implementation of global HR initiatives, projects, and transformation efforts.
* Drive process improvements and operational efficiencies across HR service delivery.
* Leverage data, analytics, and emerging tools to enhance decision\-making and HR impact.


* Champion employee wellbeing, engagement, and workplace safety initiatives for the KL GBS Office, embedding them into day\-to\-day operations
* Act as key liaison with relevant government agencies where required, including managing in\-person engagements, ensuring timely submission and filing of statutory documentation, and staying up to date with evolving local laws and regulatory requirements to maintain full compliance.
* Ensure consistent, high\-quality HR support with a strong client\-service mindset.
* Manage benefits administration and support implementation of benefits strategies and vendor transitions at the GBS KL office.
* Advise the business on policy matters, ensuring compliance with internal policies and local labor regulations for the GBS KL population.







  




**6\. Team Leadership \& Development**









  


* Manage, coach, and develop direct reports (e.g., HR Specialist), ensuring strong execution of local HR operations and capability building.


* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative, and learning\-oriented HR team environment.







  




 In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, this role may be required to support or lead additional initiatives, projects, or activities aligned with business needs and the evolving HR agenda
 








  




**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** 









  


* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business needs into HR strategies
* Proven ability to operate in a complex, matrixed, multi\-country environment
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including with senior leaders
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive insights from data
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and operate with high ownership
* Demonstrated ability to exercise effective judgment, sensitivity, discretion, and creativity in changing needs and situations
* Excellent people management and team leadership capabilities.

**Experience** 









  


* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally in a global or matrixed organization

* Prior experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist

They will be responsible for supporting and improving a culture that attracts and retains a talented, engaged, high\-performing workforce.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
* Attracts the Top Talent in our Industry. Coordinates recruitment/employment activities for all office positions. Attracts, develops, retains and motivates employees at all levels. Create and maintain a continual/active flow of candidates by utilizing advanced internet searching skills, cold and warm calling, networking, database mining, referrals, social/business websites, and other non\-traditional avenues. Engage in timely and appropriate communications with all candidates, hiring managers, recruiting managers, peer recruiters, vendors and other stakeholders to create a highly positive experience. Benchmarks employee compensation and benefits programs and provides feedback in relation to new programs, changes and renewals. Develop and manage the onboarding process for all new employees. This includes facilitating new employee orientation.
* Lead the Local Talent Planning, Critical Roles, and Succession Programs. Drive the local talent planning and succession management process, ensuring alignment with the broader global strategy. This role will partner closely with site leadership to identify critical roles, assess talent readiness, and implement development plans that support long\-term workforce sustainability. The manager will also contribute insights and data to the global talent pipeline, helping shape enterprise\-wide succession strategies and leadership development initiatives.
* Annual Review Process and Coaching: Oversee and administer annual performance review process for all local office employees. Coach managers on writing and conducting effective performance appraisals, and coach employees and managers on creating actionable goals through effective performance and development conversations.
* Function as a cultural steward and engagement of Husco. Implement the annual engagement survey, analyze results, provide data to key stakeholders, and drive action planning for improving employee engagement. Create opportunities throughout the year to promote employee engagement and satisfaction. Facilitate employee milestone moments including onboarding, performance, and separation discussions. Analyze and quantify feedback for trends and actionable changes for organizational improvement. Be available as a ‘voice of reason’ to employees and leaders for career development and coaching moments.
* Design, deliver, and maintain training programs. Lead training programs for India and partner with global HR leaders and training committees to meet organization and employee development needs. Create and deliver or partner with external experts to provide all soft skills, leadership, and technical training. Utilize training validation methods including competency testing and participant evaluations to measure training outcomes. Maintain thorough understanding of industry best practices for employee and leadership development tools and practices. Identify learning offerings and participate in the selection of vendors, suppliers and other contracted resources.
* Strong Team Player and Contributor. Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast\-paced and high\-pressure atmosphere. Combines strong attention to detail with an orientation towards results/execution. Assist with the maintenance and interpretation of all company policies, employee handbooks, and on\-boarding and orientation materials. Provide support as needed to Human Resource team members to assure the attainment of departmental objectives.

* Experience driving talent initiatives and building relationships that gain buy\-in and commitment to the value of learning initiatives.

* Ability to establish credibility and build collaborative partnerships with all levels of management and individuals across a broad range of business groups.
* Experience in aligning projects, tasks and goals with departmental and organizational strategy.
* Proficiency in verbal and written English

* Driving performance management systems and development activities
* Managing the annual People Review and ensuring feedback to individuals

title: People Experience Manager – Global Businesses & Functions
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In this role, you will shape and deliver key components of the employee experience across Global Businesses \& Functions, with a focus on inclusion, culture, and employee voice. You will work across a mix of project\-based initiatives and recurring processes, ensuring that employee insights are consistently translated into meaningful actions that improve how people experience BCG.
   

  

 You will collaborate with People Team and business leaders to identify priorities, design solutions, and drive execution. This role requires balancing structured analysis with practical implementation—connecting data, insights, and programs to deliver measurable impact.
   

  

* Analyze and synthesize employee data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities, sharing actionable insights with senior stakeholders
* Serve as GBF People Team lead for employee voice initiatives, including People Survey, pulse checks, and dashboards, ensuring insights are translated into clear actions
* Partner with leaders to co\-develop and implement action plans that strengthen engagement, inclusion, and culture
* Design and evolve programs that reinforce a strong, inclusive culture (e.g., Unlocking Potential initiatives, recognition, manager enablement)
* Build and scale frameworks, tools, and processes that enable consistent, high\-quality employee experience practices across teams and geographies
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of projects, from problem framing through execution, navigating complex stakeholder environments
* Manage recurring processes and reporting cycles, ensuring reliability, quality, and continuous improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve how employee insights and programs are delivered


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* You bring 6–8\+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, analytics, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, or a related field
* You bring strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly learn and navigate tools and dashboards (e.g., Excel, Tableau, MS Suite, AI platforms) to generate clear insights and actions
* You bring experience working with employee data, surveys, or engagement\-related areas
* You bring the ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical solutions
* You bring strong communication skills, with experience creating clear, compelling materials for senior audiences
* You bring the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across teams and levels
* You bring a high level of ownership, with a track record of independently driving successful projects end\-to\-end
* You bring an understanding of the dynamics that shape employee experience, engagement, and retention, with a demonstrated commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will be part of the Innovation, Change and Employee Experience team within the Global Businesses \& Functions People Team, working closely with colleagues across multiple pillars, including HR Business Partners, Talent Partners, Regional HR Delivery teams, Learning \& Development, and Talent Acquisition.
   

  

 You will also partner directly with business leaders and teams across Global Services, Practice Area Management \& Operations, BCG Vantage, and BCG U to translate employee insights into practical actions and initiatives. This role operates within a highly collaborative, global environment, where you will engage with diverse stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements in employee experience.
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person work is essential to our culture, mentorship, and professional development. In this role, you are expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients, approximately 50% of the time in a typical week. This position is designed for those who thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment where connection is key.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Specialist, People Operations (USA shift hours)
description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
  

  

  

 Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.
   

  

  

  

 What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
   

  





  

  

**Who we are:**




 Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, delivering high\-stakes, high\-value payments across the global education, healthcare, travel and B2B industries and, in China, Flywire partners with licensed payment partners to provide payment services to Chinese users of the Flywire platform.
   

  

  

  

 Today, we’ve digitized payments for more than 4,900\+ global clients in more than 140 currencies across 240 countries and territories around the world. And, we’re just getting started!
   

  





 With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Flywire is looking for a Senior Specialist, People Operations** 
 to join our team and work in the USA shift. The working hours for this role are
 **6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST** 
 .
   

  





 In this role, you will enhance the overall employee experience by managing core People Operations tasks, including
 **onboarding, employee relations, and data management** 
 . You will also contribute to the
 **development and implementation of People Team policies and procedures** 
 .
   

  





 As a critical thinker and problem solver, you will serve as a key bridge between employees and the broader People function, ensuring
 **smooth operations and a positive employee experience** 
 across the organization.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Onboarding \& Offboarding**



* Manage the full lifecycle of onboarding new employees and offboarding departing employees, ensuring a seamless transition experience.



**Payroll**



* Support payroll and compensation processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance, while collaborating with Finance and other stakeholders.



**Employee Relations**



* Address employee inquiries, resolve issues, and foster a positive, engaging work environment.



**Workplace Experience**



* Assist with physical workspace programs, including lease management, workspace utilization, events, amenities, maintenance, and security.



**People Data Management**



* Maintain accurate employee records, process documentation, and generate reports on personnel activities.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring data is complete, well\-documented, and audit\-ready, in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements.



**Benefits Administration**



* Assist in managing employee benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, and other perks.



**Learning \& Growth**



* Support the learning management system by assigning timely learning programs and collaborating with teams to integrate learning into the system of record.



**Policy Implementation**



* Assist in developing and implementing People policies and procedures.



**Compliance**



* Ensure adherence to relevant labor laws, regulations, and internal policies.



**People Systems \& Tools Management**



* Utilize and maintain People systems and tools to ensure accurate and efficient operations.



**Process Improvement**



* Identify opportunities to streamline People processes, improve efficiency, and enhance experiences for candidates, employees, managers, leadership, and People teams.



**Support for People Teams**



* Collaborate with other People teams on projects and initiatives to drive overall organizational effectiveness.



**In essence:** 
 The Senior Specialist, People Operations plays a pivotal role in creating a positive and efficient workplace by ensuring smooth People operations and supporting employee well\-being.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Management, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 6\+ years in Human Resources, including 3\+ years of global HR experience.
* **Organizational Skills:** 
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.
* **HR Expertise:** 
 Solid understanding of HR principles, policies, and practices, with a commitment to maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** 
 Excellent verbal and written communication, with the emotional intelligence to support diverse teams while balancing employee and business needs.
* **Proactive \& Adaptable:** 
 A self\-starter who thrives in collaborative environments, embraces change, and is comfortable wearing multiple hats.


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer:**



* Competitive compensation, including Restricted Stock Units
* Flying Start \- Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs \& Global Teams)
* Work with brilliant people that will keep you on your toes, learn more about their journeys by checking out \#InsideFlywire on social media
* Dynamic \& Global Team (we have been collaborating virtually for years!)
* Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
* Be a meaningful part in our success \- every FlyMate makes an impact
* Competitive time off including FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in and Digital Disconnect Days!
* Great Talent \& Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers!)



**Submit today and get started!**




 We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go\-to” person for any questions.
   

  





*Flywire is an equal opportunity employer. With over 40 nationalities across 12 different offices diversity, gender equality, and inclusion are at the core of our people agenda. We believe our FlyMates are our greatest asset, and we’re excited to watch our unique culture evolve with each new hire.*
