title: HR Project & Talent Intelligence Coordinator
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly organized and analytically\-driven HR professional to serve as a strategic right\-hand and execution partner supporting our Central European HR Leadership Team. Based in India, this role combines executive coordination, project management, talent acquisition market research, and regional alignment. The ideal candidate will serve as a critical liaison and enabler, managing key regional projects, talent mapping initiatives, and ensuring seamless collaboration across HR Centers of Excellence (CoE) and Experience Delivery models while maintaining compliance with global HR policies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Executive Support \& Project Management (50%)**
* Serve as strategic execution partner to the Central Europe HR Leadership Team, translating priorities into actionable plans and ensuring follow\-through
* Track and monitor progress of critical Central European HR initiatives and projects across multiple countries
* Drive accountability for delivery milestones across regional initiatives, ensuring timely completion of key priorities
* Organize and manage logistics for regional leadership meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, and materials distribution
* Contribute to the facilitation of regional meetings and produce detailed action notes with systematic follow\-up tracking
* Follow up with country HR teams, CoEs, and Experience Delivery model stakeholders on project deliverables, timelines, and action items
* Maintain project dashboards and status reports for leadership visibility in collaboration with the CoE Data Management team
* Ensure compliance with global HR policies across regional initiatives and programs \[MK1] \[RM2]
* Serve as key engagement liaison between Central Europe HR and global HR Centers of Excellence (Mobility, Compensation \& Benefits, Learning \& Development, HR Systems \[MK3] \[RM4] )
* Provide firm yet supportive follow\-up to ensure stakeholders meet commitments and deadlines


**Talent Acquisition Market Research \& Intelligence (35%)**
* Conduct comprehensive market research and competitive intelligence for talent acquisition across Central European markets under the guidance of the Head of TA for Central Europe.
* Perform internal and external talent mapping to identify potential candidates and skill availability by country and function
* Support the Head of Talent Acquisition with data\-driven insights on hiring trends, salary benchmarking, and talent availability
* Create talent landscape reports and competitive analysis by role, geography, and industry segment
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, source effectiveness, and candidate quality across the region
* Maintain talent intelligence databases and pipelines for critical roles in Central Europe, to inform hiring strategies
* Identify and recommend process improvements to recruitment processes based on market insights and data protection compliance


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management (15%)**
* Develop compelling, conceptually sound presentations using PowerPoint, Canva, and Mural etc that effectively communicate complex information to leadership and stakeholders
* Design presentation content that tells a clear story, synthesizes data into actionable insights, and supports strategic decision\-making
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Head of Talent Acquisition, Head of Northern Europe, and Head of Southern and Western Europe
* Ensure clear and timely communication of global policy updates and compliance requirements to regional stakeholders.


**Experience**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience in multinational organizations operating across multiple countries
* Demonstrated experience in multi\-country environments
* Proven track record in project coordination and stakeholder management at senior leadership levels with strong delivery focus
* Ideally experience supporting talent acquisition functions with market research and competitive intelligence
* Background in HR operations, analytics, HRBP roles, or coordination positions with exposure to regional/global projects
* Experience working with HR Centers of Excellence and shared service/Experience Delivery models


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced Excel proficiency and organizational skills including complex formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, pivot tables, data validation, conditional formatting), data structuring, and systematic file management
* Exceptional presentation design and conceptual thinking skills using PowerPoint, Canva, Mural, or similar tools—ability to craft compelling narratives and visualize complex information
* Data management and analysis capabilities with strong attention to detail
* Proficiency with HRIS systems ( Ideally Oracle, but Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar platforms also relevant)
* Experience with ATS platforms and recruitment tools
* Comfort with collaboration platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mural)


**Core Competencies**
* Strategic project management and execution with exceptional ability to manage multiple priorities and drive delivery of key milestones
* Firm but supportive stakeholder management style—able to hold people accountable while maintaining positive relationships
* Analytical thinking and data\-driven decision\-making
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in English (REQUIRED)
* Additional European languages are a strong advantage
* Market research capabilities and competitive intelligence gathering
* Highly organized with excellent time management—able to prioritize effectively and meet deadlines consistently
* Cultural agility and understanding of Central European employment markets and business practices
* Proactive problem\-solving with strong initiative and ownership mindset
* Attention to detail with high accuracy standards
* Global policy compliance knowledge and ability to translate policy into regional action


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in offshore/global delivery models for HR services
* Knowledge of Central European employment laws and talent markets across multiple countries
* HR analytics or talent intelligence certification (e.g., LinkedIn Talent Insights, HR Analytics)
* Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies
* Previous executive support or coordination experience in HR or business functions


**Working Relationships**
* Reports to: Central Europe HR Leadership Team (designated lead)
* Primary Stakeholders:
+ Head of Talent Acquisition \- Central Europe
+ Head of Northern Europe
+ Head of Southern and Western Europe

* Key Partners:
+ Country HR Managers across Central Europe
+ Global HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Management, Compensation \& Benefits, Learning \& Development, HR Systems)
+ Experience Delivery model teams (Shared Services, HR Operations)
+ Offshore and regional HR team members


**Success Metrics**
* Delivery of milestones: Consistent achievement of project timelines and deliverables across regional initiatives
* Quality and actionable insights from talent market research across Central Europe
* Effective meeting facilitation with high follow\-through rates on action items
* Stakeholder satisfaction from Head of TA, Head of Northern Europe, and Head of Southern and Western Europe
* Contribution to talent acquisition effectiveness and time\-to\-fill improvements
* Compliance adherence across regional HR initiatives
* Successful coordination between regional teams, CoEs, and Experience Delivery models
* Quality and impact of presentations and communication materials


**Work Environment \& Location**
* Location: India CSC (specific city to be determined)
* Hybrid remote work model with strong virtual collaboration capabilities
* Working hours: Alignment with Central European time zones where possible
* Fast\-paced, delivery\-focused environment supporting a globalizing organization across Central Europe
* Regular interaction with senior HR leadership across multiple countries.


 BGV:

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.  At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
   

  

**Inclusivity and Diversity**
 WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength \- Our People \-feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
   

  

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
   

  

**With us, you can.
   

  

 Apply today.**

*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

 The Human Resources Specialist plays a key role in building a positive workplace experience while supporting the organization’s people strategy. This role focuses on talent, employee engagement, and HR operations—ensuring teams feel supported, heard, and empowered to perform at their best.

title: Training Specialist
description:
**Description**
 Training Specialist Job Description
   

  

 At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon Last Mile learning team is seeking training specialist to support operations trainings to last mile vertical. Overall responsibility include boosting the competencies of our employees by developing and conducting effective training programs. The person will indirectly help enhance the employee’s workplace performance in conjunction with the company’s core values to meet the goal of organization. Amazon is an Equal Opportunity\-
   

  

 Trainer Best Behavior
   

  

 1\- Listening to associates and be supportive to managers.
   

  

 2\- Answering requests and always gets back to people.
   

  

 3\- Lead by example, doing what we say and act how we say.
   

  

 4\- Must be approachable.
   

  

 5\- Must exhibit the best behavior while at work.
   

  

 6\- Always be up to date with the latest techniques, tools, and processes.
   

  

 7\- Be right, honest, and be willing to accept mistakes.
   

  

 8\- Be willing to push their limits and accept more responsibilities.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Supervise structured learning metrices and also oversee their results for the assigned territory and region.
* Managing live performance metrices end to end for the assigned territory.
* Conducting learning session on new process as well as BQM through ITL or digital learning as per the requirement. Deliver various training courses as continuous learning.
* Maintaining data and analysis through reports on excel (as per business requirement)
* Ensure completion of new hire training program, coaching \& other performance improvement programs on time.
* Partners with operations leaders while conducting station audit to check the process compliance and fix the gaps on an immediate basis.
* Identifying learning coaches \& certifying them.
* Lead the individual improvement projects to enhance the business performance.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
* Experience using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with and delivering training/information to Associates and TL level employees

title: Vice President Human Resources
description:
**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a strategic and dynamic
 **Vice President – Human Resources** 
 to lead the people agenda across our healthcare and education ecosystem. The role will drive talent strategy, organizational development, workforce planning, employee engagement, compliance, and HR transformation initiatives aligned with institutional growth objectives.
 



 The incumbent will serve as a key strategic partner to leadership in building a high\-performance, people\-centric culture across the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Pre\-Joining Management** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment strategy and execution for faculty, clinicians, nurses and non\-clinical talent.
* Drive workforce planning, talent sourcing, assessment and selection processes.
* Strengthen hiring quality through structured evaluation frameworks and training of line managers on selection methodologies.
* Build robust talent pipelines to support organizational growth.



**2\. Selection, Onboarding \& Orientation** 



* Oversee seamless onboarding and orientation programs for new hires across business units.
* Design and institutionalize structured induction processes to ensure faster integration and productivity.
* Partner with departmental leaders to enhance candidate and employee experience.



**3\. Employee Life Cycle Management** 



* Lead the complete employee lifecycle from onboarding to development, engagement and retention.
* Drive learning \& development initiatives, leadership capability building and succession planning.
* Oversee performance management, appraisal and rewards systems that foster high performance.
* Develop and monitor HR metrics and dashboards including attrition, absenteeism, compensation trends and workforce analytics.
* Support current and future business needs through talent development, engagement and retention strategies.
* Foster a positive, collaborative and high\-performing work culture.



**4\. Employee Relations \& Severance Management** 



* Manage employee relations, grievance handling and conflict resolution.
* Oversee labor mediation, disciplinary matters and claim handling.
* Ensure fair, compliant and dignified separation and severance processes.



**5\. HR Strategy, Policy \& Transformation** 



* Develop and implement progressive HR strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Review, strengthen and institutionalize HR policies, systems and SOPs across the group.
* Lead organizational development and HR transformation initiatives.
* Drive regulatory compliance awareness through policy communication and training programs.
* Act as a bridge between management and employees to strengthen trust and engagement.



**6\. Administration, Compliance \& Legal** 



* Ensure legal and statutory compliance across all aspects of human resource management.
* Oversee HR administration related to faculty and staff matters.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth institutional operations.
* Support governance, audits, compliance reviews and other strategic or operational responsibilities as assigned.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources / MSW or equivalent from a reputed institution.
* 15\+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, preferably in healthcare organizations.
* Proven experience in strategic HR, talent management, employee relations and compliance.
* Experience in leading large, diverse and multi\-location teams preferred.



**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic HR Leadership
* Talent Management \& Organizational Development
* Workforce Planning \& Succession Management
* Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution
* HR Analytics \& Performance Management
* Policy, Compliance \& Labor Law Expertise
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management \& Culture Building
* Strong Business Acumen and Leadership Presence



  





**Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹18 LPA (negotiable for the right candidate).

title: SDR SaaS Sales – Fresher
description:
**About Shinkly**

Shinkly Private Limited is a software company building modern SaaS products, including Voidfull \- https://voidfull.com (all\-in\-one content management) and LogChimp \- https://logchimp.app (customer feedback collection).

We focus on building high\-quality, product\-led software and scaling these products to a global audience. As an early\-stage startup, we believe in experimentation, learning quickly, and working closely together to build meaningful products.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **highly driven fresher** who has completed **at least 7 months of internship in tech/SaaS sales** and wants to build a serious career in B2B SaaS.

This is not a “lead gen” role — you’ll get **exposure to the full sales cycle**, working directly with the founder to generate pipeline, talk to prospects, and contribute to closing deals.

If you’re curious, hungry, and willing to learn by doing — this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and research potential customers (startups, SaaS teams, founders)
* Reach out via cold email, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads
* Conduct initial discovery calls to understand customer pain points
* Support demos and follow\-ups with prospects
* Maintain CRM and track sales pipeline consistently
* Work closely with the founder on messaging, positioning, and GTM experiments
* Share insights from conversations to improve product and sales strategy

**Who Should Apply**

* Fresher with minimum 7 months internship experience in tech/SaaS sales, or BD
* Strong communication skills (written \+ verbal)
* Comfortable talking to new people and handling rejection
* Self\-starter who can work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment
* Curious mindset — willing to learn sales by actually doing it
* Basic understanding of SaaS or B2B products

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience with cold emailing / LinkedIn outreach
* Exposure to CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)
* Experience working in a startup or remote team
* Understanding of Product\-Led Growth (PLG)

**What You’ll Get**

* Hands\-on exposure to real SaaS sales (not just theory)
* Opportunity to work directly with the founder
* Learn full sales cycle — from prospecting to closing
* Fast growth based on performance (not tenure)
* Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, analytically driven individual who thrives on making sense of numbers, processes, and business realities. This role sits at the heart of how we run, improve, and grow our business — and you will be expected to bring structure, curiosity, and a bias for action to everything you do.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Strategy Consultant, your primary focus will be on ensuring the business unit runs efficiently — tracking performance, strengthening controls, writing and improving processes, and driving operational excellence. Over time, you will also support strategic initiatives including M\&A evaluation and IPO\-related data preparation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Unit P\&L \& Operational Performance
* Own the monthly P\&L review process — track revenue lines, cost heads, gross margins, and EBITDA; identify variances against budget and prior periods.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports, financial dashboards, and performance scorecards for leadership on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Analyse trends in revenue, cost, and profitability across business lines, customers, and geographies to surface actionable insights.
* Monitor working capital metrics — debtor days, creditor days, inventory levels, and cash flow patterns — and flag concerns proactively.
* Track and report on key business KPIs; build simple models to forecast performance and test sensitivities.
* Assist in annual budgeting and quarterly re\-forecasting exercises by compiling inputs, challenging assumptions, and preparing consolidated views.
* Design and maintain internal control mechanisms to prevent revenue leakage, cost overruns, and compliance lapses.
* Conduct periodic internal audits of transactions, approvals, and reconciliations; escalate exceptions to the reporting manager.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables; liaise with accounts team to ensure timely closures and accurate books.
* Process Writing \& Continuous Improvement
* Document existing business processes across departments in a structured, clear format — creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flowcharts, and control checklists.
* Identify process gaps, redundancies, and manual workarounds; propose and help implement streamlined alternatives.
* Work with teams on the ground to understand how work actually gets done vs. how it is supposed to get done — and design practical solutions that stick.
* Establish a process review calendar and ensure SOPs are updated periodically to reflect changes in operations, regulations, or systems.
* Track implementation of process improvement initiatives and measure impact through defined metrics (turnaround time, error rates, cost savings, etc.).
* Support automation and digitisation efforts by mapping current processes and identifying candidate workflows for technology intervention.
* Build a centralised process documentation repository accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) Support
* Assist in identifying and profiling potential M\&A targets — compile company overviews, financial summaries, and industry context.
* Build and maintain financial models for deal evaluation — including revenue projections, cost structures, and basic valuation frameworks (DCF, revenue multiples).
* Prepare structured investment briefs and evaluation summaries for presentation to decision\-makers.
* Support due diligence by collating and organising financial data, contracts, regulatory filings, and operational information.
* Track relevant sector trends, publicly available deal data, and comparable transaction benchmarks.
* IPO Readiness — Data \& Preparation Support
* Assist in collating and organising historical financial data, operational metrics, and business disclosures required for IPO documentation.
* Compile inputs for the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) as directed — primarily data gathering, formatting, and fact\-checking.
* Coordinate with auditors, legal advisors, and merchant bankers to provide requested information in a timely manner.
* Maintain an IPO readiness tracker covering pending action items, document submissions, and milestone timelines.
* Prepare basic benchmarking data on listed peer companies — valuations, financials, and disclosure formats — for reference by senior advisors.


**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) — Fresher or up to 2 years post\-qualification (preferred)

**Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong analytical mindset — ability to structure problems, work with numbers, and present findings clearly.

* High ownership mindset — takes tasks to completion without needing to be followed up.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, multi\-priority environment where the scope of work evolves.
* Intellectual curiosity across domains — finance, operations, strategy, and business law.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in designing and implementing networking systems.
* 3 years of experience with TCP/IP\-based, routing, and network management protocols.

**Preferred qualifications:**

**About The Job**
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define, and develop the implementation of test strategies and architectures for critical WAN infrastructure projects.
* Design and execute comprehensive functional, integration, performance, and system\-level testing for complex network devices and management systems.
* Drive the creation and enhancement of scalable test automation frameworks, tools, and infrastructure.
* Collaborate closely with Network Architecture, Software Engineering, and Product teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and influence design for testability.

 The Role
   

  

 We’re looking for a hands\-on Network Engineer to design, deploy, and enable our global corporate network across offices in APAC. You’ll be the technical expert for physical and virtual networking architecture, driving automation, and ensuring our infrastructure is resilient, scalable, and vendor\-agnostic. This role will partner closely with Corporate Technology, Network Security, and Security Engineering and requires the ability to travel within APAC to support our regional offices.
   

  

 What You’ll Do

* Manage Cisco Meraki switches/routers and APs, while staying vendor\-agnostic for future integrations.

* Build secure cloud and hybrid networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Automate deployments and configuration management with Python, Ansible, and IaC tools (Terraform, GitOps).
* Implement observability and alerting; drive improvements in MTTR and service reliability.
* Support compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) with configs, change control, and documentation.
* Travel regionally (approx. 25–40% during buildouts) for on\-site deployments and architecture reviews.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 8–10\+ years in enterprise networking, with multi\-site design and operations experience.
* Deep expertise in routing, switching, and segmentation.Proven experience with Cisco networking technology, especially Cisco Meraki.
* Proficient in Python and Ansible for automation.
* Skilled in NAC/RADIUS integrations with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD).
* Strong understanding of certificate\-based authentication, EAP, and zero\-trust architectures.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and leadership skills.
* Willing and able to travel internationally for deployments.


**Nice To Have**
* Cloud networking depth (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with SASE/ZTNA platforms(Cloudflare/Zscaler).
* Professional certifications (CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, etc.)

 unexpected.

 had to settle on model due to tariff season. isc dhcpd usable.

 DHCP by vendor, require crash carting/manual full reset in order
 



 to DHCP

 configured to be reachable via OOB network

 bring into network

 ■ Coordinate w/devops on SONiC build pipeline
 



 ○ Transition from ad\-hoc to code\-driven configuration

 ■ Firewall rules engine appears to favor single source interface for all
 



 src/dst resulting in erroneous packet drops
 



 ■ Ensure upstream egress/ingress A/P functioning correctly
 



 ● Will need to work with network team of colocation vendor
 



 providing IP transit to remedy IP transit only having one
 



 functioning leg at present
 



 ○ May require on\-site work/coordination
 



 ● Ensure direct connect multipath correctly working
 



 ○ Ensure no overly eager security features negatively impacting legitimate traffic
 



 (session drops/throttling, unreasonable latency impacts, etc \- currently see
 



 \~200ms hit on some traffic)
 



 ○ Ensure no unlicensed security features enabled (I believe dnssec is currently
 



 erroneously enabled)
 



 ○ NAT public ips for use
 



 ○ Interzone traffic rules currently permissive to avoid issues in early deployment \-
 



 More mature tiered scheme necessary for long term
 



 ○ Coordinate w/devops on firewall integration with monitoring
 



 ● Console network setup
 



 ○ Physical topology of 2x OpenGear OM2224 spines and 16x Opengear IM7248
 



 ToRs
 



 ○ Current state is spines routable, providing loop for firewall mgt ports, cellular not
 



 active, ToRs lack ethernet routing, all end\-device access currently through nested
 



 console sessions
 



 ○ FRR experience required, OpenGear experience bonus
 



 ○ OpenGear cellular fallback does not play nicely with multipath \- destroys routing
 



 when triggered \- cellular fallback should be manually implemented, simple
 



 systemd timer with heartbeats over various paths is all that’s needed
 



 ○ Set up direct to end\-device serial console via ssh (existing feature, just needs to
 



 be config’d after ethernet routing is set up)
 



 ○ Set up standardized versions for IM7248s, OM2224s
 



 ○ Set up standardized credentials for IM7248s \+ OM2224s
 



 ○ Need business cellular plan for OM2224s \- previously used prepaid consumer
 



 (not an option \- AT\&T allows OpenGears but bars Palo Alto traffic on consumer
 



 plan). Verizon 4G coverage in colo area is inconsistent. One of TMobile’s 4G
 



 bands is unsupported by OM2224’s modem.
 



 ■ At least 10GB/mo on each, 50\+ preferred \- It’s for emergency access,
 



 there is a world where we catastrophic failure requires recovery involving
 



 pushing images over these connections, hitting plan limit in an emergency
 



 is the last thing we should ever deal with

This role will focus on all aspects of enterprise networking including datacenter, backbone, market data, co\-lo and end user environments.
   

  

 The Asia Networks team is part of the Asia Infrastructure team with expertise across infrastructure disciplines including Data Center Management, Windows, Unix, Cloud , Information Security and virtualization. The role will be able to work with technical engineers and clients that span global offices across the US, EMEA, and APAC.

* Engineering, operations and implementation role in enterprise networks across all aspects of the network, including Market Data, low latency execution, datacenter, backbone, desktop connectivity, corporate Wi\-fi and remote offices.
* Serve as an escalation point for critical issues. Help connect the global team to key network challenges and advocate for the needs of the APAC region.

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: ERP Business Analyst - Tax Management
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The ERP Tax Management team acts as a technical partner, managing digital solutions for indirect tax, direct tax, and transfer pricing. This multi\-cultural, dynamic group leverages a mix of complementary skills to navigate and implement new tax mandates across the globe. Their primary mission is to design standardized global templates that provide a consistent digital framework for the entire organization. Simultaneously, they must remain agile enough to adapt these templates to meet unique local requirements for different affiliates. By bridging the gap between tax law and IT systems, they ensure seamless compliance across all international entities. They are responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of technical mandates that protect the company's global financial position.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 In this role, you will be a key driver in our digital tax transformation, ensuring our global operations remain compliant and efficient. Your mission is to bridge the gap between complex tax laws and innovative IT systems within a dynamic team environment.
   

  

* Design Automated Logic: You will analyze intricate business requirements to design and deliver advanced automated tax determination logic within SAP S/4HANA using condition techniques.
* Drive Cross\-Module Integration: You will ensure seamless integration of tax requirements across SD, MM, and FI modules to maintain consistent tax treatment throughout the entire supply chain.
* Lead Digital Reporting: You will support the technical setup for local statutory requirements, focusing on high\-impact areas like real\-time reporting and e\-invoicing (e.g., SDI, CFDI).
* Manage Tax Engines: You will configure and maintain critical interfaces between SAP and external tax engines such as ONESOURCE or Sovos for real\-time, accurate rate calculations.
* Bridge Business and IT: You will act as the primary liaison, translating complex global tax laws into clear, actionable functional specifications for technical teams.
* Ensure System Quality: You will lead comprehensive end\-to\-end testing cycles, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Mitigate Global Risk: You will proactively resolve complex production issues where tax calculations or e\-invoice submissions fail in high\-volume transaction environments.
* Foster Innovation: You will contribute to the evolution of our global standardized templates, balancing consistency with the agility needed for local affiliate requirements.


 Who you are
   

  

 You are a proactive problem\-solver who thrives on the intersection of technology and finance. You bring a meticulous approach to compliance and a passion for optimizing digital frameworks.
   

  

* Experienced Professional: You possess a minimum of 8\+ years of hands\-on implementation experience, including at least two full project lifecycles as an SAP SD/MM functional consultant.
* Academic Foundation: You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.
* Tax Subject Matter Expert: You have expert knowledge of SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST) setup, with deep experience in complex EU tax rules within large MNC environments.
* Technical Troubleshooter: You possess strong ABAP debugging skills, allowing you to effectively troubleshoot complex tax calculation and interface issues.
* Regulatory Tech Specialist: You have experience implementing e\-invoice submission frameworks; familiarity with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) is a significant plus.
* Collaborative Communicator: You demonstrate excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across a multi\-cultural environment.
* Language Proficient: You are fluent in English (written and verbal), which is essential for our global collaboration and documentation. \#RDT2026


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: SDE-1
description:
****DESCRIPTION****
 AEE is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to work on our expansions tech stacks, which enables to launch new stores with local language, local currency, local payments and build new features and enhancements to work on an S team goal. The expansions strategy, and roadmap is one of the most important initiatives across Amazon. You will design, architect and innovative technology solutions that will reduce time to market, standardize execution and scale for expansion globally. You will build, operate and play a key role in the evolution of our platform to solve the world's most complex technical challenges in Information extraction, Large\-scale computing, Distributed systems, Web applications, Data mining, Scalability, Security, and Algorithms to name a few. You’ll strive for simplicity, and demonstrate significant creativity and high judgment. You will play a key role in stabilizing the day to day operations and improving the platform’s build and testing process, and ensure adherence to organizational software and security compliance.
   

  

 The job is simple: make everything available to everyone all the time at the best possible price. The requirements are almost as simple \- we’re looking for leaders and trailblazers who aren’t afraid of tackling massive scale, layered complexity and ambiguous requirements to empower our customers to shop the World. No two features are ever the same and our customers are hungry for every single one!
   

  

**What To Expect Day\-to\-day:**
* Solve complex problems through data, rapidly.
* Design and develop state of the art software systems that address these complex and ambiguous problems.
* Own the inputs and the business outcome through cultivating a culture of relentless auditing and metric monitoring, automatically where possible.


 This is a contractual position which is ideal for candidates who are looking to deal with scaling challenges at Amazon and ready to build mission critical system software applications and tools. It is also an opportunity for freelance candidates to become domain experts and have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture and development of consumer products. Depending on individual performance this experience can lead to permanent positions as Software Development Engineers at Amazon.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**What To Expect Day\-to\-day:**
* Solve complex problems through data, rapidly.
* Design and develop state of the art software systems that address these complex and ambiguous problems.
* Own the inputs and the business outcome through cultivating a culture of relentless auditing and metric monitoring, automatically where possible.


****BASIC QUALIFICATIONS****
* 1\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Job Description**
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* In this role, you’ll help Translate Emerson’s digital transformation goals into executable, scalable agent development activities.
* Work for AI\-enabled applications and agent\-based solutions.
* Implement AI agents within the Ovation Intelligence ecosystem.
* Work with team of AI engineers, software developers, and domain SMEs in developing AI agents.
* Actively participate in the design and implementation of the Agent Builder platform used to create custom user agents for diagnostics, automation, engineering workflows, and operational support.
* Ensure the quality of the agents to meaningfully improve operator awareness, reduce troubleshooting time, enhance engineering productivity, and enable predictive maintenance workflows.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, and domain SMEs to define agent use cases and deployment strategies.
* Work with Cybersecurity teams to enforce Emerson’s rigorous security standards for AI\-driven solutions.
* Work with infrastructure and platform teams to align compute, GPU usage, and performance requirements.


**Who You Are:**
 You have a strong bottom\-line orientation. You learn quickly when facing new situations. You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations. You introduce new ways of looking at problems. You orchestrate multiple activities simultaneously to accomplish a goal.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or related fields.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML model development, deployment, and optimization, with a track record of driving innovation and efficiency in real\-world applications.
* Experience with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent architectures, and industrial AI applications.
* Understanding of distributed systems, cloud/on\-prem architectures, APIs, and enterprise software development practices.
* Understanding of software development processes, including definition of requirements, testing and validation, and deployment.


**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**
* We’re looking for someone with strong expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI, including LLMs, Agentic AI and its applications. Proficiency in C\#, Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch is essential, along with hands\-on experience deploying AI in real\-world, industrial environments.
* Prior experience with Emerson Ovation, industrial control systems (DCS/SCADA), or power plant operations.
* Knowledge of operational technology (OT) networks, cybersecurity principles, and safety\-critical system constraints.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated or mission\-critical environments.
* Familiarity with ML Ops, prompt engineering, and AI reliability frameworks.


**Our Culture \& Commitment to You**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
   

  

 We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
   

  

 We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
   

  

 At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.
   

  

**Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation**
 If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .
   

  

**About Emerson**
 Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
   

  

 With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
   

  

 We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Challenges**
 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development, and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. Though we engineer for a 50million\+ strong user base, we code with every individual user in mind. title: Frontend Engineer (India)
description:
**About Onehouse**
 Onehouse is a mission\-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock\-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud\-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute\-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real\-time AI / ML).
   

  

 We are a team of self\-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large\-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self\-optimizing data lake platform!
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2\-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category \- the transactional data lake. The Product Engineering team is the glue that binds all of this together. We enable our data platform and infrastructure teams to be successful by acting as the foundation of a truly cloud native product.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Drive:**
* You aren't just building a UI; you are building the command center for the transactional data lake. Your work sits at the intersection of complex distributed systems and high\-performance user interfaces.
* Architecting AI\-Native Data Experiences: You will lead the development of generative AI interfaces that allow users to talk to their data infrastructure. Imagine building natural language interfaces that auto\-generate schemas or debug complex data pipelines in real\-time.
* Visualizing Massive Scale: You’ll solve the "dense data" problem—crafting performant, intuitive visualizations for petabyte\-scale data flows using React, Next.js and Typescript, ensuring that managing a global data lake feels as simple as managing a spreadsheet.
* Bridging the gRPC Gap: You will help define how we stream complex infrastructure states to the frontend, leveraging gRPC\-web to create a snappy, low\-latency experience that feels "local" even when managing remote cloud clusters.
* Defining a Category: As an early hire, your DNA will be in the product. You’ll influence the UX patterns of a new industry category, moving the needle from "clunky enterprise software" to "elegant cloud\-native platform."


**A Typical Day:**
* No two days are the same in a scaling startup, but here is what your rhythm looks like:
* Getting Started: You start with a sync with your lead engineers. You might be discussing how to build new feature into product with right approach.
* Deep Work Phase: You’re in the zone with Next.js and gRPC, building out a sophisticated features. You’re likely writing new shared components to ensure our UI is as robust as our backend.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You will work with EM/PMs to discuss upcoming features and define next milestones.
* State Management \& Logic: You spend time optimising our Firebase integration for real\-time notifications or wiring up gRPC services to ensure the frontend is perfectly synced with the underlying infrastructure.
* Direct Impact: You ship code that immediately improves how our customers interact with transactional data.
* Oncall: You will build alerts, logging and sophisticated tooling to make sure customer experience never degrades.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Frontend engineer with experience developing and operating frontend applications
* Experience with React and gRPC.
* Operational excellence in monitoring/deploying/testing frontend applications.
* Great problem\-solving skills, a keen eye for details
* Quick decision making, self\-driven and able to balance to feature development and tech debt
* Clear communication skills
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience with Firebase or equivalent DB.
* Experience working on a SaaS product.


**How We'll Take Care Of You**
* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health \& Well\-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well\-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well\-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote\-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America \+ India), though some roles will be subject to in\-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 11 paid company holidays
* Food \& Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in\-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one\-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

description:
"Team is the Tech we build at CynLr"
 



  





*Alignment of a resource begins before they join and not after.*

 *act as the face of the organization*

*Link to Detailed JD \- https://www.cynlr.com/careers?country\=India\&category\=HR\&role\=HR%2FTA\+\-\+Associate\#open\-roles* 









**1\. Talent Research and Mapping** 




 a. Discovering, classifying, and mapping talent pools and market availability of skillset \& job titles with internal assessment of roles and functions required by the organization
 



 b. Using job portals like LinkedIn, Naukri etc… to obtain and document information on current talent market – including map of skillsets and interest areas commonly mentioned by candidates on resumes and online profiles
 



 c. Mapping universities \& colleges for fresher talent across technical and business roles
 



  





**2\. Job Description Creation, Posting \& Campus Recruitment Drives** 




 a. Working with domain teams and branding teams to create compelling JDs for open roles
 



 b. Publishing and managing job postings on online portals to generate high quality talent pipelines for roles of interest
 



 c. Coordinating with campus placement teams to ensure maximal reach to students during campus placement drives, ensuring larger and more relevant fresher pipelines
 



 d. Coordinating with recruitment/head\-hunting firms to source further talent
 



  





  





**3\. Talent Pipeline Tracking, Evaluations, and Interviews** 




 a. Tracking and having timely communication with talent pipeline sourced though job postings, campus drives and recruitment agencies
 



 b. Scheduling evaluations in coordination with domain teams
 



 c. Scheduling and coordinating interviews with potential candidates
 



 d. Obtaining timely and pertinent feedback from candidates on their interest in continuing with the engagement and course correcting as required
 



 e. Persuading/encouraging promising candidates to participate in further evaluations and interviews
 



  





**4\. Compensation Research, Discovery, and Mapping** 




 a. Understanding market trends in compensation for different roles under consideration
 



 b. Assist in assessing specific candidate’s market worth for role under consideration accounting for the skillset the candidate can bring on the table and the amount of training and grooming the organization is required to invest on the candidate
 



 c. Objectively mapping market worth for the specific role and skillset with candidates’ expectation on compensation and taking appropriate steps to address any mismatch of expectations
 



  





**5\. Talent Onboarding** 




 a. Preparing job offer and employment agreements
 



 b. Performing due diligence on the candidates before onboarding
 



 c. Ensuring collection of all requisite legal and personal information about the candidates
 



 d. Enrolling on payroll software, helping candidate setup for Income Tax
 



 e. Updating Leave Balances as per policy
 



 f. Educating new hires on all operational internal policies including leave and attendance, IT \& Devices, POSH etc…
 



  





**6\. Payroll \& Reimbursements** 




 a. Verifying payroll data and finalizing the same
 



 b. Reviewing all reimbursement claims and coordination of approvals for the same
 



 c. Ensuring processing of payroll on last working day of the month
 



 d. Ensuring all salary payments are credited on time
 



  





**7\. Leave \& Attendance** 




 a. Working with management to periodically review and update leave and attendance policies as per evolving organizational requirements
 



 b. Keeping payroll/attendance tracking system updated with the policies
 



 c. Ensuring all employees are adhering to the ethos of the policies and following due process in obtain leave of absences
 



 d. Ensuring all approvals are in place on a periodic manner prior to payroll processes
 



  





**8\. Appraisals \& Salary Revision Tracking \& Updating** 




 a. Working with management track and assign salary appraisal cycles for each employee
 



 b. Updating employment documents with appraisal/salary revisions information
 



 c. Updating and verifying payroll software for revisions in compensation
 



  





**9\. Statutory Compliances** 




 a. Ensure statutory payments \& compliances such as PT Payments, PT Filing, EPF Payments
 



 b. Ensuring compliance as per various central and state laws pertaining to labour, including POSH, Shops \& Establishment etc…
 



  





**10\. Employee Exits** 




 a. Ensuring proper documentation for exits of employees
 



 b. Coordinating with IT for recovery of all company devices and ensuring no residue of confidential information is in the possession of the departing employee
 



 c. Updating payroll software and preparing for full\-and\-final settlement
 



 d. Ensuring no\-dues is acknowledged
 



 e. Tracking past employees for breach of contract or non\-disclosure terms post exit
 



  





**11\. Assisting Employer Branding \& Communication Activities** 




 a. Working closely with Branding team in helping execute employer branding and marketing activities
 



 b. Helping Branding and Marketing teams in identifying datapoints pertaining to lack of awareness or perception lapses amongst various talent pools
 



 c. Tracking public reviews by employees on CynLr on portals such as Glassdoor, encouraging employees to update reviews, salary information etc… and provide timely feedback to management of the status of the public perception of employer brand
 



 d. Ensuring reach and distribution of internal branding and marketing communications to all employees
 



 e. Helping in executing Founders’ messaging to employees and in disseminating key messaging pertaining to the vision of the company, progress, and milestones etc… including coordinating hosting of town\-halls, team meetings and company events
 



  





**Job Requirements**




  





**1 . Domain \& Tool Knowledge:** 



* Business Operations Understanding
* Communication Fundamentals
* HR Operations
* Employer Branding
* Handling Negotiations
* Familiarity with major job portaks \- LinkedIn, Naukri etc and Applicant Tracking System Tools.
* Familiarity with payroll software.
* Strong hold on MS Office tools.



  





**2 . Skills:** 



* Excellent with organization, documentation, and interfacing with external entities.
* Excellent professional communication skills and negotiation skills.
* Understanding of human psychology and skilled in managing personnel expectations.
* Organizational thinking



  





**3 . Behavioural Tendency:** 




  




* **Critical Thinking** 
 , Available, Responsible, Versatile, Resourceful, Thorough \&
 **Attention to Details.**








  





**How will your Career Progress?**




  





 We envision this role to be the genesis of what would eventually be a
 **foundational pillar** 
 for
 **Human Resources Management.** 




 Needless to say, the exciting yet demanding part of a start\-up \- every passing day, the Company grows and the needs change,
 *expansively* 
 .
 



 In this context, beyond excelling as a Generalist in the current Role, which will grow as the organization expands, it also opens doors, and the role can evolve into leadership roles in Talent Strategy \& Acquisition, Internal HR Management, HR Compliance, Designing Compensation Models, Culture etc…
 



  





***About CynLr***




  





 As a foundational technology building company in Robotics \& AI,
 
 CynLr
 
 builds visual robots that
 
 can intuitively learn to pick \& handle even unknown objects without requiring any prior training
 
 , just like a human baby fiddles with objects. CynLr calls this stack as Object Intelligence (OI).
 



 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries.
 



 With OI's ability to learn on the fly, CynLr’s focus is to universally automate factories and eliminate the need for complicated custom machines to manufacture products.
 



 Thereby simplifying manufacturing into
 
 Universal Factories
 
 , which can be programmatically repurposed to produce wide varieties of Products. CynLr envisions the future factories to be decentralized, micro factories (not the Giga Factories) that could rather be hosted in your street\-ends; opening up the possibility of Personalized Products – liberating design of products from the constrains of manufacturability.

description:
**Job Description**
 The Renewable Energy Systems Engineer will support WSP’s renewable energy systems engineering capability across utility‑scale solar, wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This role is responsible for delivery excellence across the full project lifecycle — from early development through commissioning and operations.
   

  

 The position plays a key role in strengthening WSP’s renewable energy engineering platform by establishing consistent renewable energy standards, scalable delivery models, and high‑quality client outcomes. The engineer will be involved in projects with our Systems Engineering Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and model solar PV systems, Wind and BESS for utility\-scale, commercial, and microgrid applications using PVsyst, PVcase, and AutoCAD.
* Perform layout optimization, shading analysis, energy yield simulations, and loss assessments.
* Use NREL’s SAM or other bankable software for financial modeling, performance forecasting, and system cost\-benefit analysis.
* Conduct site assessments, review topographical data, and analyze meteorological datasets (e.g., TMY, DNI, GHI).
* Develop and maintain bill of materials (BOM), schematics, and as\-built drawings.
* Coordinate with interconnection, civil, and structural teams to ensure complete system integration.
* Support permitting, interconnection applications, and technical documentation for proposals and contracts.
* Develop augmentation optimization models for BESS systems
* Develop vendor\-specific system RTE calculations and ensure desired BESS output
* Collaborate with project managers, EPC partners, and other stakeholders to ensure design quality and technical compliance.
* Stay current on codes and standards (e.g., NEC, UL, IEEE, IEC) relevant to solar system design.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in solar PV \+ BESS system design, preferably across utility, commercial, and microgrid scales.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, PVcase, PVsyst, and NREL SAM.
* A good understanding of North America markets, such as familiarity with North American EPC’s, Vendors etc.
* Strong understanding of PV system components, design standards, and layout strategies.
* Strong understanding of BESS system components, design standards, and US fire safety codes

**Human Resources (HR) Executive**

**Position Summary:** We are seeking an approachable and highly organized HR Professional to oversee our company’s human resources operations. You will be responsible for managing the full employee lifecycle, ensuring statutory compliance with Kerala state regulations, and fostering a positive workplace culture.

* **Performance Management:** Assist department heads in rolling out annual or bi\-annual performance appraisals, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs), and identifying training and development needs.
* **HR Administration:** Maintain and update employee records digitally and physically. Draft and enforce HR policies, issuing letters (probation, confirmation, experience) as necessary.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

* **Education:** MBA in Human Resources, Master of Social Work (MSW) in HR, or a related degree.
* **Experience:** 2–5\+ years of proven HR experience in India (experience within Kerala is highly preferred).
* **Compliance Knowledge:** Practical, hands\-on knowledge of Indian statutory compliances (PF, ESI, PT) and local labor regulations.

##### **Role:**


##### **SuperProcure is looking for an HR Intern, as part of the HR team the job is to extend support in recruitment, HRIS, and employee engagement activities. This is a great opportunity for pre\-final/final year students or freshers \- experiential learning opportunity in a fast\-paced startup environment.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


#### **Recruitment:**


* Help draft clear and role\-specific job descriptions
* Post job openings on job portals, social media, and other platforms.
* Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on defined criteria.
* Conduct basic HR screening calls to assess candidate fit.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and keep candidates updated
* Manage recruitment metrics

#### **HRIS:**


* Assist in preparing onboarding documents for new hires.
* Help maintain and update the employee database.
* Employee personnel file and compliance data management.

  

**Employee Engagement:**


* Support the planning and execution of fun team activities and events.
* Share creative ideas to improve employee morale and keep teams engaged.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**


* A pre\-final/final year student interested in HR with *\>65% throughout career*
* Internship experience in recruitment or HR.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with basic tools like Google Sheets, MS Excel, Presentation skills

  

**Other Requirements:**


* Providing a NOC from your Institute is a must have to proceed with this internship

  

**About SuperProcure**  



  

SuperProcure is a next\-generation end\-to\-end TMS platform with multi\-enterprise collaboration for shippers. It digitizes and automates all processes across the logistics value chain from vehicle sourcing to freight accounting, ensuring stakeholder collaboration, real\-time visibility \& transparency. We are determined to make the lives of the logistic teams easier, add value, and help in establishing a fair and beneficial process for businesses. SuperProcure is trusted by a diverse customer base spread across manufacturing \& construction industries to boost their customer serviceability with cutting\-edge technology solutions


Indian logistics spent is 14% of GDP, against 7\-9% in developed countries. This makes the Indian industries less competitive in the international market and extra spent for domestic consumers. The logistics inefficiency is driven by manual processes spread across multiple stakeholders who work in silos to complete transportation of goods. SuperProcure aims to revolutionize Indian logistics to save 1% of GDP spending and make India globally competitive, enabling collaboration on a single platform, and driving logistics efficiencies.


Our clients include some of the fortune 500 companies such as Tata Chemicals, Havells, KEI, ITC, PepsiCo, Tata Consumers, Dawaat, L\&T Constructions, Aditya Birla, MP Birla Corporation, Sun Pharma, many more.

  

  

SuperProcure is backed by IndiaMart \& IIM Calcutta. It has been recognized for its innovation at the CII Industrial Innovation Awards, was recognized amongst the Top 50 Emerging start\-ups in India by NASSCOM, and ranked Asia's top 10 TMS solution providers by the Global Supply Chain Council (GSCC) and ChainTech.

  

  

  

**Life @ SuperProcure**

  

SuperProcure operates in an extremely innovative, entrepreneurial, analytical, and problem\-solving work culture. Every team member is fully motivated and committed to the company's vision and believes in getting things done. In our organization, every employee is the CEO of what he/she does; from conception to execution, the work needs to be thought through.

  

  

Our people are the core of our organization, and we believe in empowering them and making them a part of the daily decision\-making, which impacts the business and shapes the company's overall strategy. They are constantly provided with resources, mentorship, and support from our highly energetic teams and leadership. SuperProcure is extremely inclusive and believes in collective success.

  

  

Looking for a bland, routine 9\-6 job? PLEASE DO NOT APPLY. Looking for a job where you wake up and add significant value to a $180 Billion logistics industry every day? DO APPLY.

  

  

**Team:** SuperProcure's success is fueled by our diverse \& talented team of 170\+ members, 50%\+ of whom are women. Together, we collaborate with a shared passion for innovation and excellence. From visionary leaders \& meticulous engineers to creative designers \& customer support specialists, each plays a crucial role in our growth. We build lasting relationships, understand unique needs, and exceed expectations by delivering cutting\-edge tailored solutions.


**Culture**: All challenges and fun associated with start\-ups. Competitive salary, responsibilities, flat hierarchy, daily challenges, long working hours, delivery pressure, and a fun workplace.
